Vontobel has received Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) approval to market six of its strategies to retail investors in Hong Kong.

The newly authorized funds include: Strategic Income Fund, Absolute Return Credit, Emerging Markets Debt, Emerging Markets Corporate Bonds, mtx Asian Leaders and Global Environmental Change.

Wei Kai Lee, head clients APAC, Middle East and Africa at Vontobel said: “Hong Kong is one of the key financial centres globally and a strategically important market for Vontobel.”

“The registration of these retail funds expands Vontobel’s investment capabilities available through our distribution partners and supports the continued development of our business in Hong Kong and across the region.”

The Zurich headquartered firm has $300bn in assets under management, as of the end of June 2026.

Lee added: “This milestone reflects our commitment to the market and our long-term growth ambitions across Asia Pacific.”
